trends.name: US-Iran Ceasefire Breakdown Risk
trends.summary: Fragile Iran-US ceasefire deteriorating with Iran claiming US violations and threatening control of Hormuz shipping. Trump warns military action could resume, with IRGC Navy asserting control over oil exports through Strait. Escalation directly threatens oil prices and regional stability.

trends.name: Oil Price Surge & Energy Disruption
trends.summary: Oil rebounds as Hormuz passage threats loom, with Goldman Sachs warning of $115/barrel by year-end. Emerging market input prices rising steeply amid Middle East tensions. Energy sector volatility testing resilience across indices and commodity-linked strategies.

trends.name: Precious Metals & Gold Correction
trends.summary: Gold experiencing sharp decline amid geopolitical hedging reassessment and shifting investment flows. Market correction reflects changing risk appetite as investors rebalance away from traditional safe havens given Middle East developments.

trends.name: US Economic Data Beating Estimates
trends.summary: US Economic Surprise Index surges to 0.338, highest since October 2023, indicating consistent data beats vs. estimates. S&P 500 regains key moving averages in rare display of strength, signaling market resilience and potentially supporting equity valuations.

trends.name: Asian Markets Weakness & Currency Volatility
trends.summary: Asia-Pacific equities declining as investors assess ceasefire risks; Japanese consumer confidence crashes to 33.3 (est 38.3), signaling weakening sentiment. Asian currencies consolidating amid geopolitical uncertainty and capital flow concerns.

trends.name: AI Model Competition & Capex Arms Race
trends.summary: Meta launches new AI model attempting to catch Google and OpenAI after billions in spending. OpenAI prepares retail IPO with share allocation, signaling major tech investment cycle. Race for AI dominance intensifying competition and capital requirements.

trends.name: Rare Earths & Copper Commodity Boom
trends.summary: Copper market surge as 'rush is just getting started' amid industrial demand. Rare earths sector calls for state intervention to reshape markets, reflecting supply chain concerns and geopolitical pressures affecting critical minerals.

trends.name: Pentagon AI Contractor Blacklisting
trends.summary: Appeals court allows Pentagon to maintain Anthropic designation as supply-chain risk, blocking company's bid for reversal. Signals escalating tech-defense sector tensions and potential restrictions on AI contractor relationships affecting market valuations.

trends.name: GLP-1 Oral Medications & Healthcare Markets
trends.summary: Oral GLP-1 treatments now available, reshaping diabetes and obesity treatment landscape. Credit markets may not fully reflect profit implications from broader accessibility of oral formulations vs. injectables, creating valuation opportunities.

trends.name: NATO Rifts & Military Repositioning
trends.summary: Trump's Greenland and NATO rhetoric deepening alliances strain; US plans to move troops out of NATO countries deemed unhelpful to Iran war effort and station them in supportive countries. Reflects major geopolitical realignment affecting defense spending.

trends.name: Prediction Markets & Betting Platform Growth
trends.summary: Kalshi dominates US prediction market with 91% share as trading volumes surge. Growing retail participation in political/economic outcome betting reflecting shift from traditional derivatives to event-based wagering.

trends.name: Climate Risk & El Niño Food Price Pressures
trends.summary: Super El Niño event poses fresh risks to global food costs amid geopolitical tensions. Agricultural commodity pressures could combine with Middle East disruptions to inflate broader inflation concerns and impact emerging market exports.
